subject: Create config module (src/config/config.ts)
description:
Create `src/config/config.ts` with:
- `HaystackConfig` interface (googleApiKey, outputDir, baseArtworkDir, defaultModel, defaultAspectRatio?, defaultSeed?, maxStoredOutputs)
- `loadConfigFromEnv()` — reads from process.env: GOOGLE_API_KEY/GEMINI_API_KEY, HAYSTACK_OUTPUT_DIR, HAYSTACK_ARTWORK_DIR, HAYSTACK_MODEL, HAYSTACK_ASPECT_RATIO, HAYSTACK_SEED, HAYSTACK_MAX_OUTPUTS with sensible defaults
- `toPipelineConfig(config)` — converts HaystackConfig to Partial<PipelineConfig>

Also create `src/config/index.ts` with re-exports.

Depends on: types.ts (Task #2)
